plain_language_description: Internal REDCap mortality record identifier.
why_retained: Needed to return a flagged death to the source REDCap record and to merge selected Step 2 evidence to the matching private Step 1 death for future DCO processing. Private; never public.

plain_language_description: Date of death used by the analytical workflow.
Calendar year of death.
Calendar month of death.
Calendar quarter of death.
Sex code recorded in the source mortality record.
why_retained: Retained for downstream stratification; Step 2 does not recode it.

plain_language_description: Age value recorded on the death certificate.
why_retained: Used together with agetxt to interpret age.

plain_language_description: Unit/code that describes how the source age value is expressed.
why_retained: Needed to interpret age correctly, especially infant deaths.

plain_language_description: Residence parish code recorded in the source mortality record.
why_retained: Retained for possible downstream stratification; publication remains subject to disclosure control.

plain_language_description: Step 1 flag: death date is missing or invalid.

Step 1 flag: source death year disagrees with the derived death date.
Step 1 flag: registration date is missing or invalid.
Step 1 flag: source marks the record as a possible duplicate.
Step 1 flag: all six cause-of-death text fields are blank.

Step 1 flag: age value or age-unit code is missing or invalid.
Step 1 flag: one or more upstream QA flags are present.

Confidence in whether the surviving electronic record preserves the original certificate line structure.
values_or_format: 1 Lines preserved; 2 Known BNR-concatenated representation; 3 Structure/provenance uncertain
why_retained: Controls whether Clear classification is allowed; it is not a disease rule.

plain_language_description: Indicates whether source structure is good enough to support Clear/Conservative classification.
why_retained: Simple downstream flag for Conservative availability at record level.

plain_language_description: Pattern of populated Part I lines, for example a, ab, abc, abcd or blank.
why_retained: Makes the certificate structure visible without retaining internal detector flags.

plain_language_description: Lowest populated Part I line.
why_retained: Key plain structural input to the approximation.

plain_language_description: Indicates a gapped or non-standard Part I pattern, such as I(a) and I(c) with I(b) blank.
why_retained: Flags a structure in which simple causal interpretation is less reliable.

plain_language_description: Automated evidence class for BNR-Heart as the approximate underlying cause of death.
values_or_format: 1 Clear; 2 Likely; 3 Possible; 4 Mention only; 5 No evidence

plain_language_description: Stable rule identifier that explains why the final automated Heart evidence class was assigned.
why_retained: Analytical provenance. IDs are never recycled for a different released rule.

plain_language_description: Plain-language explanation of the Heart rule recorded in hrt_rule.
why_retained: Allows the DTA and review file to be understood without opening Stata code.

plain_language_description: Primary nosology/provenance identifier supporting the Heart decision where a specific external principle applies.
Type of Heart evidence found, such as explicit AMI, IHD/coronary disease, both, or sudden cardiac death.
why_retained: Separates surveillance-family classification from the diagnostic wording that supported it.

plain_language_description: BNR surveillance-scope provenance identifier for the broader fatal-event Heart definition.
values_or_format: NOS017 when Heart evidence is present
why_retained: Documents why fatal BNR-Heart surveillance is not restricted to certificates literally saying AMI.

plain_language_description: Indicates that a Heart classification that would otherwise be Clear was reduced to Likely because source line structure is not preserved.
